summary: Generated a new parallel spec verifying the Logs Quick Mode pin-to-toolbar behavior (pin renders toolbar toggle, unpin removes it, state persists across reload, toolbar toggle flips Quick Mode, and the pin button is decoupled from Quick Mode).

tests.title: should render the pinned Quick Mode toolbar toggle after pinning
tests.verifies: clicking the pin button renders the pinned Quick Mode toolbar toggle and sets the pin button to the pinned (primary) color

tests.title: should unpin Quick Mode and remove the pinned toolbar toggle
tests.verifies: clicking the pin button while pinned removes the toolbar toggle and returns the pin button to the unpinned (grey-6) color

tests.title: should persist the Quick Mode pin state across page reload
tests.verifies: a non-default pin state (unpinned) survives a page reload instead of resetting to the default pinned state

tests.title: should toggle Quick Mode using the pinned toolbar toggle
tests.verifies: clicking the pinned toolbar toggle flips the Quick Mode state (q-toggle__inner truthy/falsy)

tests.title: should not toggle Quick Mode when clicking the pin button
tests.verifies: clicking the pin button changes only the pin state and leaves Quick Mode unchanged (decoupled controls)
